finding: The official cover replaces the rejected generic rover as the overall anchor. Rev4 preserves the steep cabin, shells, broad wheels and open chassis; it also restores the separate Bionicle Zamor sphere launcher, rear drill cup/collar and the docked spacecraft's wedge canopy, side tubes and two rear fins. One low outer wing plate is visible; the source requires its far-side pair, but this raster does not prove that occluded plate.
